joshua.22.p1.b1.text: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh

joshua.22.p1.b2.text: All this time you have not deserted your brothers, up to this very day …

joshua.22.p1.b3.text: You may return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you across the Jordan.

joshua.22.p1.b4.text: But be very careful … to love the LORD your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His commandments, to hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

joshua.22.p2.b1.text: So Joshua blessed them and sent them on their way … To the half-tribe of Manasseh Moses had given land in Bashan, and to the other half Joshua gave land on the west side of the Jordan among their brothers.

joshua.22.p2.b2.text: Return to your homes with your great wealth … Divide with your brothers the spoil of your enemies.

joshua.22.p2.b3.text: So the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in the land of Canaan to return to their own land of Gilead …

joshua.22.p3.b1.text: And when they came to Geliloth near the Jordan in the land of Canaan,

joshua.22.p3.b2.text: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh built an imposing altar there by the Jordan.

joshua.22.p3.b3.text: Then the Israelites received the report … have built an altar on the border of the land of Canaan, at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side.

joshua.22.p3.b4.text: And when they heard this, the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh to go to war against them.

joshua.22.p4.b1.text: The Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the land of Gilead … With him they sent ten chiefs

joshua.22.p4.b2.text: They went to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and said to them,

joshua.22.p4.b3.text: What is this breach of faith you have committed today against the God of Israel by turning away from the LORD and building for yourselves an altar, that you might rebel against the LORD this day?

joshua.22.p5.b1.text: And now, would you turn away from the LORD? If you rebel today against the LORD, tomorrow He will be angry with the whole congregation of Israel.

joshua.22.p5.b2.text: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us, from which we have not cleansed ourselves to this day?

joshua.22.p5.b3.text: Was not Achan son of Zerah unfaithful regarding what was set apart for destruction … Yet it was not only Achan who perished because of his sin!

joshua.22.p5.b4.text: If indeed the land of your inheritance is unclean, then cross over to the land of the LORD’s possession … and take possession of it among us.

joshua.22.p6.b1.text: The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know.

joshua.22.p6.b2.text: But in fact we have done this …

joshua.22.p6.b3.text: What have you to do with the LORD, the God of Israel? … You have no share in the LORD!

joshua.22.p6.b4.text: Not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.

joshua.22.p7.b1.text: Today we know that the LORD is among us, because you have not committed this breach of faith against Him. Consequently, you have delivered the Israelites from the hand of the LORD.

joshua.22.p7.b2.text: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, together with the other leaders, returned to the Israelites in the land of Canaan and brought back a report regarding the Reubenites and Gadites in the land of Gilead.

joshua.22.p7.b3.text: The Israelites were satisfied with the report, and they blessed God and spoke no more about going to war against them to destroy the land where the Reubenites and Gadites lived.

joshua.22.p7.b4.text: So the Reubenites and Gadites named the altar Witness, for they said, “It is a witness between us that the LORD is God.”
